newsitem.title: USA: TWA June passenger load factor declines.
newsitem.headline: TWA June passenger load factor declines.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Tuesday its passenger load factor for June declined to 74.3 percent from 74.8 percent a year ago.
For the year-to-date period, however, load factor rose to 68.7 percent from 66.9 percent, it added.
TWA said its revenue passenger miles for the month declined to 2.32 billion from 2.64 billion. Available seat miles for the month dropped to 3.13 billion from 3.53 billion.
TWA said that, due to a planned downsizing of aircraft on some international routes, both capacity and traffic declined from June 1996 levels.
The airline added that it posted significant improvement in both on-time performance and schedule reliability in June.
